description: How the parties around a Kees de Boekhouder subscription relate to each other: who wins and onboards the client, who assigns and backs up the personal bookkeeper, how bookings flow from the client to review and filing, how partnerships and companies are served through the VOF package and Founders, how money flows through the fixed monthly fee, and how professional associations and service partners feed members into the brand.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Intro calls, plan choice, switches, plan changes and partner agreements

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Bookings submitted, administrations reviewed, returns filed and clients assigned

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Monthly subscription fees, add-ons, membership fees and partner products

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Questions, advice, proactive updates, capacity signals and member benefits

relations.name: Runs the intro call and onboards the freelancer
relations.description: Hosts the free Google Meet introduction, checks the mutual fit, explains the €840 sole-proprietor plan and the first-fiscal-year rule, and opens the account so the creative freelancer can start uploading.

relations.name: Guides the starter into the Starters package
relations.description: Explains what a starter needs before the first quarter — KVK registration, VAT number, the KOR choice and the startersaftrek — and sets up the same subscription with starter guidance and first-upload coaching.

relations.name: Requests an intro and asks the starter questions
relations.description: Books the free introduction from the website, often while still employed, and brings the questions about part-time entrepreneurship, VAT and deductions that decide whether the fit check succeeds.

relations.name: Switches the freelancer from a previous bookkeeper
relations.description: Collects digital copies of earlier VAT and income tax returns and personal data, confirms that no external accounting software is carried over, and continues the administration without a gap in the filing history.

relations.name: Contracts Founders for the holding and operating company
relations.description: Chooses the €1,750 holding or €2,450 werkmaatschappij plan, including the transition from an eenmanszaak to a BV, and agrees payroll for the DGA salary as an add-on.

relations.name: Assigns onboarded clients to a personal bookkeeper
relations.description: Matches each new or switched client to a bookkeeper in the Amsterdam, Rotterdam or Utrecht office based on legal form, sector and available capacity, and hands over the onboarding notes and imported history.

relations.name: Flags capacity, churn risk and plan mismatches
relations.description: Reports portfolio load, clients whose activity has stalled, entities that outgrow their plan (a first employee, a partner, a BV) and cancellation signals so client success can act before the monthly notice arrives.

relations.name: Submits receipts, invoices and bank transactions
relations.description: Photographs receipts through Scan & Herken, sends quotes and invoices from the app and keeps the Ponto bank connection authorised so that matched transactions and bookings arrive in the bookkeeper's review queue.

relations.name: Reviews the administration and files VAT and income tax
relations.description: Checks the submitted bookings each quarter, files the VAT return before the deadline, prepares the annual accounts with the applicable deductions and files the income tax return, and reminds the client of what is still missing.

relations.name: Asks tax position, deduction and Wet DBA questions
relations.description: Raises questions by e-mail or phone about what to reserve, which deductions apply, a mortgage application, working for one large client under the Wet DBA, or whether a BV makes sense, and reads the dashboard before asking.

relations.name: Gives advice and proactive updates
relations.description: Answers with consistent, knowledge-base-backed advice, updates the client about deadlines and rule changes that affect them (zelfstandigenaftrek reduction, KOR, Wet DBA enforcement) and schedules a video or in-person meeting when a decision is large.

relations.name: Splits the profit and files each partner's return
relations.description: Maintains the shared VOF administration, calculates the profit split per partner, files the partnership's VAT returns and each partner's income tax return, and explains who owes what.

relations.name: Reports partner and employee changes and supplies payroll data
relations.description: Notifies the bookkeeper when a partner joins or leaves or a first employee is hired, and supplies the employee or DGA data for monthly payslips and wage tax filings at €17.50 per payslip.

relations.name: Files corporate tax, annual accounts and KVK filing through Founders
relations.description: As a Founders bookkeeper prepares the corporate tax return, the statutory annual accounts and the KVK filing for the holding and operating company, runs the DGA payroll and advises on salary, dividend and holding structure.

relations.name: Pays the monthly subscription and add-ons
relations.description: Pays the fixed yearly fee in monthly instalments together with add-ons such as the €5 bank connection per account or a €125 partner income tax return, and handles plan changes and cancellations with one calendar month's notice after the first fiscal year.

relations.name: Offers a member benefit and referral discount
relations.description: Promotes Kees to its members — designers, photographers, artists, makers — with a benefit such as no administration costs, months free or a discount, and points them to the partner landing page for an intro call.

relations.name: Pays membership fees and buys partner products
relations.description: Pays the association's membership and takes insurance, pension, legal or crowdfunding products from the partner, often on the bookkeeper's suggestion, which is why the partner values the referral relationship.

relations.name: Agrees partner benefits and reports referrals
relations.description: Negotiates the referral benefit and landing page with the association or provider, tracks referred members from request to active client and reports benefit uptake back to the partner.
